title: Bridgework fireline standup — customer snapshots 2026-06-22
agenda: Quick customer health snapshots (3 min each)
notes:
Quickfire notes from the 22-Jun fireline standup. Intentionally terse — capture status, risks, and next steps so field teams can act.

Calypso Analytics (Danny Lee):
- Current state: POC into Dedicated pool v2 running on p4d. Baseline throughput meets SLA for 2k reqs/min after warmup. Intermittent 503s when KV cache misses spike during morning batch.
- Recent actions: Marco applied a cache-size bump and reduced KV eviction threshold (PR referenced). Observed fewer misses in staging.
- Risk: TLS cert for customer-managed gateway set to rotate 2026-06-25. Customer expects zero downtime; need validated cert reload path for NGINX sidecars.
- Ask: Can SRE validate cert rotation in canary region (us-west2) before Friday?

Northbridge Financial (Nora Kim):
- Current state: Private deployment on VPC peered air-gapped lane. Migration plan to new quantized model (q4_0) caused small semantic drift in alerting rules (entity extraction map changed).
- Recent actions: Jillian ran eval suite; F1 drop ~0.02 on our critical intents. Product recommended a canary with fallback to float32 model.
- Risk: regulatory sign-off pending for ephemeral logs; paperwork expected back 2026-06-29. If delayed, we postpone full rollout.
- Ask: Solutions team to prepare rollback playbook and automated metric thresholds for immediate revert.

Aster Healthcare (internal pilot):
- Current state: Hosted API integration for triage bot. Latency SLO mostly fine, but token-cost spike due to unbounded system prompt expansion when patient notes include long transcripts.
- Recent actions: Added prompt length guard and token-based sampling. Early tests show 18% cost reduction.
- Risk: Some edge cases where guard truncates needed context, introducing hallucinations.
- Ask: Product to sign off on safety prompt template and eval 500 transcripts through pipeline.

Platform-level items:
- Autoscale/queue tuning (ENG-1423): Samir updated queue depth to prefer low-latency routing for premium customers; requires one more load test. Load test scheduled 2026-06-24.
- Kernel mismatch on q4_0 quant (serving-runtime PR #764): Observed non-deterministic logits for batch size > 8. Investigating whether kernel rounding differs across GPU types. Marco to loop in runtime team.
- VPC peering handshake flakiness: Observed occasional broken routes after peering refresh. SRE suspects route-table race during refresh. Temporary mitigation: stagger peering refresh across subnets.

Decisions made during standup:
- Certificate rotation for Calypso: run dry-run in canary (us-west2) on 06/24, actual rotation 06/25 evening with on-call SRE present. Owner: Samir.
- Northbridge rollback playbook: Jillian + Aisha to author playbook and automate metric checks by 06/26 EOD.
- Kernel investigation: Marco to open kernel-qa matrix and assign to runtime leads; target triage meeting 06/24.

Notes-to-self / loose threads:
- Confirm whether private-deploy agent supports hot-reload of TLS without restart (urgent for Calypso).
- Collect 200 transcripts for Aster evaluation; Priya to coordinate with customer success.
- Check infra costs: Dedicated p4d run scaling vs q4_0 cost delta — finance flag for next week if >10% change.
